title: Restore workspace watcher coverage for a negated Git ignore rule
outcome: A behavioral Git fixture proves that an ignore rule still suppresses an ordinary ignored path and keeps a re-included sibling visible through the production workspace watcher classification route.
acceptance: A fixture repository with a plain Git ignore pattern and a negated rule exercises the existing watcher classification route. It observes that events for the re-included file remain visible and events for an ignored sibling are suppressed.
